manifest.name: Payment - Account
manifest.summary: Enable customers to pay invoices on the portal and post payments when transactions are processed.

relations: filters available payment-method lines by provider state; blocks delete while a provider is enabled/test

views.note: No own views; xml_loc=701 is view inheritance only (account.move / payment.provider / payment.transaction / account.payment forms, portal templates, payment-form templates).

behavioral_notes.observation: Overrides payment's base _post_process. For each tx whose state is 'done' it first posts any draft linked invoices (invoice_ids.filtered(state=='draft').action_post()), then -- unless it is a 'validation' operation, already has a payment_id, or its children already settled -- calls tx.with_company(company)._create_payment() to materialize the accounting payment. It then writes a chatter note on the tx, its account.payment and the linked invoices ('The payment related to transaction ... has been posted'). For txs whose state is 'cancel' it calls tx.payment_id.action_cancel(). This is the settlement hook payment's engine leaves abstract; metadata shows neither the cross-model creation nor the state-gating.

Builds account.payment vals from the transaction: amount=abs(self.amount); payment_type 'inbound' if amount>0 else 'outbound'; journal_id=self.provider_id.journal_id; payment_method_line_id = that journal's inbound_payment_method_line_ids filtered to this provider; partner=commercial_partner_id (partner_type='customer'); carries payment_token_id, payment_transaction_id and invoice_ids. For a posted invoice eligible for an early-payment discount it appends counterpart write_off_line_vals (_get_invoice_counterpart_amls_for_early_payment_discount); destination_account_id is taken from the invoice's 'payment_term' line. It then creates the account.payment, calls payment.action_post() (which the account module turns into a balanced account.move), stores the one2one payment_id, and finally RECONCILES: (payment.move_id.line_ids + invoices.line_ids) on payment.destination_account_id (the receivable account), not-yet-reconciled -> .reconcile(). That reconcile is what flips the invoice's payment_state to in_payment/paid. None of this (journal pick, AR-account match, reconcile) is visible in field metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: account.move 'Pay Now' portal gate + amount_paid / payment_state link
behavioral_notes.observation: account.move gains transaction_ids (m2m account_invoice_transaction_rel) and a computed amount_paid = sum of transaction amounts whose state is in {'authorized','done'} (depends on transaction_ids). _has_to_be_paid() is the boolean controlling whether the portal shows the 'Pay Now' dialog: it requires ir.config_parameter 'account_payment.enable_portal_payment' true AND state=='posted' AND move_type=='out_invoice' AND a non-zero amount_residual AND payment_state in {'not_paid','in_payment','partial'} AND no still-pending provider transaction; _get_online_payment_error() returns the matching human message when the gate is closed. payment_state itself is owned by the account module via reconciliation (this module feeds it by reconciling in _create_payment); amount_paid here is a parallel display figure summing live transactions, not the ledger residual. payment_action_capture()/payment_action_void() let the backend capture or void an invoice's authorized_transaction_ids.

payment.provider.journal_id (domain type=bank, check_company) is a compute/inverse pair: _compute_journal_id finds the account.payment.method.line whose payment_provider_id is this provider (else, for enabled/test providers, the first bank journal), and _ensure_payment_method_line()/_inverse_journal_id keep an account.payment.method.line in sync -- creating one (name=provider name, code=provider code, payment_account_id=outstanding/transfer account from the chart template) and stamping payment_provider_id+journal_id on it, or unlinking it when the journal is cleared. account.payment.method.line._compute_payment_provider_id back-fills the provider for 'electronic'-mode method lines and refuses to delete a line linked to an enabled/test provider. account.journal._get_available_payment_method_lines hides lines whose payment_provider_state=='disabled', and account.journal blocks its own deletion while a non-disabled provider points at it. _setup_provider/_remove_provider create/delete the matching account.payment.method on (un)install. This is how a configured online provider becomes a usable inbound payment method on a bank journal -- pure Python, invisible to metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: portal controllers: /invoice/transaction/<id> and account.payment.action_post token charge
behavioral_notes.observation: controllers/payment.py (PaymentPortal extends payment's portal): /invoice/transaction/<int:invoice_id> (jsonrpc, public) checks the invoice access token, then _process_transaction -> _create_transaction with custom_create_values {'invoice_ids': Command.set([invoice_id])} so the draft payment.transaction is born already linked to the account.move; it returns the tx processing values. /invoice/transaction/overdue batches all same-currency overdue invoices into one transaction. payment_pay() is overridden to inject the invoice's reference/currency/partner/company; _get_extra_payment_form_values reroutes transaction_route to /invoice/transaction/<id> and landing_route back to the invoice portal page. Separately, account.payment.action_post() is overridden so a payment carrying a payment_token_id but no transaction first _create_payment_transaction() + tx._charge_with_token() ('offline' card-not-present), then posts only if the resulting tx state is 'done' (else action_cancel) -- the backend 'pay by saved card' path.

behavioral_notes.element: frontend (static) -- portal Pay-Now interactions + PaymentForm patch
behavioral_notes.observation: 3 JS files, 0 XML/OWL: two public.interactions are registered -- account_payment.portal_invoice_page_payment (selector #portal_pay; opens the Bootstrap '#pay_with' Modal on the portal invoice page when data-payment is set) and account_payment.portal_my_invoices_payment_list -- plus a patch of PaymentForm.prototype (extends the shared payment widget for the invoice/overdue context). Assets land in web.assets_frontend. These public interactions are not represented in Python model/field metadata (gap #3).

it_architecture.application: account_payment (Payment-Account bridge component; auto_install with account)
information_flows: depends: account, payment (this module is the bridge between them)
inbound: acquirer webhook/redirect -> payment.transaction done -> _post_process override
side-effect: payment.transaction._post_process -> posts draft account.move, calls _create_payment
side-effect: payment.transaction._create_payment -> creates+posts account.payment (=> balanced account.move via account) and reconciles invoice AR lines -> invoice payment_state
config: payment.provider.journal_id <-> account.payment.method.line (provider becomes an inbound bank-journal payment method)
portal: /invoice/transaction/<id> -> _create_transaction with invoice_ids preset; PaymentForm patch reroutes transaction/landing routes to invoice portal
frontend_components: account_payment.portal_invoice_page_payment (public interaction; opens #pay_with modal on portal invoice)
PaymentForm.prototype (patch of the shared payment widget for the invoice/overdue context)

external_integrations.note: This bridge makes no outbound acquirer calls itself; the actual HTTP to acquirers lives in the base payment engine (payment.provider._send_api_request) and per-provider modules. uses_api_keys is inherited transitively via the payment dependency. Inbound settlement arrives through payment's webhook/redirect controllers and is handled here via the _post_process override.

capabilities: Pay Invoices Online (portal self-service checkout for customer invoices)
Auto-Post & Reconcile Payments from confirmed transactions
Pay-by-Saved-Token from the backend register-payment / payment flow
Provider-to-Journal Configuration (online provider as an inbound payment method)
value_streams: Collect-AR-Online: portal 'Pay Now' (/invoice/transaction) -> payment.transaction -> acquirer -> done -> _post_process -> _create_payment (account.payment) -> reconcile invoice -> payment_state in_payment/paid
Settle-Authorized: authorized transaction -> payment_action_capture -> child capture tx done -> account.payment + reconcile
Refund-Collected: account.payment.amount_available_for_refund -> payment.refund.wizard -> refund transaction -> negative/outbound account.payment
organization: (no module-owned res.groups; relies on account's accounting groups and payment/portal record rules; 1 own record rule + 3 access rules)
policies: ir.config_parameter 'account_payment.enable_portal_payment' gates whether invoices can be paid online (account.move._has_to_be_paid)
Online payment only for posted out_invoice with non-zero residual and payment_state in not_paid/in_payment/partial, and no pending provider transaction
account.journal / account.payment.method.line cannot be deleted while linked to an enabled or test payment.provider
Uninstall is blocked if account.payments already use a provider's payment method (data-integrity guard)
stakeholders: Payment Acquirer (external; reached via the payment engine, not this module)

classification.apqc_category: 9.0 Manage Financial Resources (9.2.x process accounts receivable / 9.5.x process payments)
classification.rationale: account_payment is a financial-management SUPPORT extension, not a primary value activity. It is a thin bridge (1 own model + 11 inherit-only extensions, no own views) whose job is to connect the cash/payment rail (the payment engine: payment.transaction / payment.provider / payment.token) to the accounts-receivable ledger (the account module: account.move / account.payment / reconciliation). Its central side-effect -- payment.transaction._post_process -> _create_payment -> action_post + reconcile invoice -- is exactly the act of recording the financial consequence of a collection event into the double-entry ledger, i.e. APQC 9.0 Manage Financial Resources: 9.2.x process accounts receivable (mark the customer invoice paid) and 9.5.x process payments / collect cash (post the account.payment). It does NOT mediate the parties itself (the value-network mediation -- onboarding acquirers, provisioning the transaction, the requests-based acquirer link -- lives in the 'payment' engine, classified network); and it does NOT transform inputs into outputs (chain) or solve a bespoke customer problem (shop). On the enterprise value chain it sits under the accounting/finance support function alongside its parent 'account' (also support/support). Hence value_model=support, activity_class=support -- inheriting account's classification rather than payment's, because its own logic is ledger record-keeping, not mediation.

standard_capabilities: pay a customer invoice online from the portal (Pay Now dialog, single or overdue-batch)
automatic creation + posting of an account.payment when a transaction is confirmed
automatic reconciliation of that payment against the invoice (payment_state -> in_payment/paid)
pay-by-saved-token from the backend (account.payment.action_post / register payment)
manual capture / void of authorized transactions from the invoice
wiring an online provider to a bank journal as an inbound payment method line
payment links with installment / early-payment-discount awareness
typical_fits: B2B/B2C customers paying posted invoices online through a supported acquirer
self-service collection of overdue invoices in one batch transaction
tokenized follow-up charges initiated by the accountant against an invoice
multi-company / multi-provider setup, each provider bound to its own bank journal
common_gaps: needs a live payment_<provider> module (Stripe, PayPal, ...) underneath -- this bridge ships no acquirer
online payment is gated off by default (ir.config_parameter enable_portal_payment must be enabled)
out_invoice only -- paying vendor bills / other move types online is out of scope of _has_to_be_paid
bespoke reconciliation / outstanding-account mapping beyond the standard payment-method-line outstanding account
custom settlement document chains (subscriptions, deposits) need their own _create_payment/_post_process overrides
drive_hints: odoo shell: tx=env['payment.transaction'].search([('invoice_ids','!=',False)],limit=1); print(tx.reference, tx.state, tx.payment_id, tx.invoice_ids.mapped('payment_state'))
curl jsonrpc /invoice/transaction/<invoice_id> (auth=public, needs invoice access_token) to start a portal invoice payment

open_questions: Exact account.payment -> account.move synchronization and which outstanding vs liquidity accounts the chosen payment_method_line resolves to (owned by the account module's _synchronize_to_moves).
How partial captures / voids split reconciliation across source vs child transactions and their invoices in real data.
Real-world share of invoices actually paid online vs by other means, and tokenized-charge usage (no runtime row counts captured).
Behavior of the early-payment-discount write-off path (_get_invoice_counterpart_amls_for_early_payment_discount) on multi-installment invoices.
